info.anchor: A short word, e.g. press. A link to #press scrolls to the section with the same anchor.
info.caption_colour: Choose the colour that reads best over the photograph
info.collection_kind: Candles have no Available / Sold tabs; sold out candles stay in the grid with a label.
info.color_moss: The only accent: primary buttons, footer background and hover
info.color_mount: Square mount behind every painting image
info.colors: The paintings are the colour. These defaults are the approved palette, so change them with care.
info.contact_details: Used in the footer and on the Contact page. Anything left blank is hidden.
info.content_source: Hide this link when its section has no entries yet.
info.delivery_options: One choice per line, for example Deliver to me. Leave empty to hide the field.
info.download_url: Upload a PDF in Content > Files and paste its link here.
info.enquiry_type: Shown at the top of the email Andrea receives, e.g. Trade enquiry
info.events_source: Entries come from Content > Metaobjects > Event, newest first.
info.favicon: Square image, at least 180 x 180. Shown in browser tabs and on phone home screens.
info.font: Jost Light is the approved typeface. Regular and Medium weights load automatically.
info.footer_contact_details: Email, phone, WhatsApp and Instagram are set in Theme settings > Contact details.
info.header_menu: Use up to 6 links: Art, Candles, Features, My story, For designers, Contact.
info.heading_tag: Use Page title once per page, for the main heading
info.hero_image: A lifestyle or installation photograph, at least 2400px wide. It fills the full width.
info.hero_more: Add up to two more photographs. One of the three shows at random on each visit.
info.hide_newsletter_on_form_pages: Those pages already have a form, so one is enough.
info.homes_source: Entries come from Content > Metaobjects > Home installation.
info.kind: Only products of this type are shown. Set each product's type to Painting or Candle in the admin.
info.lifestyle_image: A lifestyle or installation photograph. It fills the frame and is not mounted.
info.logo_text: Shown in capitals with wide letter spacing.
info.meta_description: Used for search results and link previews when a page has no description of its own.
info.minimum_to_show: With fewer paintings than this, the section is hidden.
info.more_works_collection: Sold paintings and the current painting are skipped
info.page_intro_heading: Leave blank to use the page title
info.portrait_image: A portrait photograph, shown at 4:5 and filling the frame.
info.press_source: Entries come from Content > Metaobjects > Press article, newest first.
info.reassurance: One line each. Only include what is true.
info.redirect_collection: Visitors who reach /cart are sent here. Defaults to available works.
info.region_label: Read out by screen readers, not shown
info.rotate_count: One of these shows at random on each visit. Choosing a testimonial above shows only that one.
info.share_image: Shown when a page is shared on WhatsApp, Instagram or LinkedIn. Best at 1200 x 630.
info.show_contact_details: Email, WhatsApp and Instagram from Theme settings > Contact details.
info.show_project_fields: For trade enquiries from interior designers
info.show_scale: Drawn from the Dimensions field (width x height).
info.show_tabs: The Works page always has the tabs.
info.sold_heading: Used instead of the heading when the painting is tagged sold
info.testimonial: Leave blank to show the first testimonial
info.whatsapp_number: International format, e.g. +27 82 000 0000. Shows a WhatsApp chat link.
info.works_intro: Shown under the heading when the collection has no description of its own.
info.year_lists: Add a List heading block, then the entries that belong under it. Drag blocks to reorder.
info.show_heading: The page is already named in the navigation, so the title is hidden by default. Search engines and screen readers still read it.
info.page_heading: Makes the heading the page’s main title (h1), starts the section just below the header and loads the image first. Use it on the first section of a page only.
info.size_guide_collection: Paintings are drawn to scale from their Dimensions field (width x height), beside a 1.7 m figure. Paintings without dimensions are skipped.

labels.caption: Caption
labels.heading: Heading
labels.hide_newsletter_on_form_pages: Hide the newsletter on Contact and For designers
labels.minimum_to_show: Minimum paintings to show the section
labels.only_with_designer: Only show homes credited to a designer
labels.show_project_fields: Show studio, project and timeline fields
